candidates.title: Генпрокурор Калифорнии допустил уголовное преследование Nvidia и ее экс-главы Дженсена Хуанга
candidates.summary: Компания Nvidia и ее бывший гендиректор Дженсен Хуанг могут попасть под уголовное преследование в Калифорнии, заявил генпрокурор американского штата Роб Бонта агентству Bloomberg. Причины. Калифорнийская прокуратура начала расследование в отношении компании и ее бывшего главы, сейчас оно находится н
candidates.full: Компания Nvidia и ее бывший гендиректор Дженсен Хуанг могут попасть под уголовное преследование в Калифорнии, заявил генпрокурор американского штата Роб Бонта агентству Bloomberg. Причины. Калифорнийская прокуратура начала расследование в отношении компании и ее бывшего главы, сейчас оно находится на начальном этапе, рассказал Бонта. По его словам, ведомство направило Nvidia повестку с требованием предоставить информацию. На сайте Минюста Калифорнии говорится, что генпрокурор штата запросил у компании данные о том, могли ли ее передовые чипы или конфиденциальная информация попасть в Китай, а также вводила ли Nvidia инвесторов и общественность в заблуждение. Если выяснится, что Nvidia и Хуанг сознательно обманывали инвесторов и общество по поводу продаж передовых чипов Китаю, это может стать причиной для уголовного преследования, пояснил генпрокурор Калифорнии. «Основной правовой базой, на которую мы опираемся, являются предусмотренные законодательством Калифорнии запреты — в рамках как гражданского, так и уголовного права — на введение инвесторов и общественности в заблуждение», — сказал Бонта. Новая газета. Европа — Читайте также Если расследование придет к выводу, что Nvidia и Хуанг нарушили закон, от компании могут потребовать вернуть прибыль от незаконных продаж, отметил генпрокурор. Он добавил, что уголовное преследование также может привести к штрафам. Другие расследования. Президент США Дональд Трамп заявил, что ФБР расследует связи Хуанга с бывшей главой сингапурской компании Megaspeed Элис Хуанг, которую подозревают в сотрудничестве с китайской разведкой. Министр финансов США Скотт Бессент отметил, что собственное расследование Nvidia поможет установить, допустила ли компания «безответственный» подход к продаже передовых микросхем, из-за чего они могли оказаться в Китае. Скандал с главой Nvidia. 12 ноября Дженсен Хуанг ушел с поста гендиректора компании и покинул совет директоров на фоне сообщений о его отношениях с Элис Хуанг. За женщиной наблюдали спецслужбы США и, как утверждают источники NYT, пришли к выводу, что она передавала информацию Пекину. Затем они обнаружили ее близкие отношения с Хуангом. Пекин отрицает, что Элис Хуанг была шпионкой. Генпрокурор США Тодд Бланш 12 ноября заявил, что Министерство юстиции еще не пришло к выводу, связана ли она со спецслужбами КНР.

candidates.title: ONU va stabili reguli privind folosirea în luptă a „roboților ucigași". Care este principalul dezacord între statele membre
candidates.summary: ONU va stabili reguli privind folosirea în luptă a „roboților ucigași”. Care este principalul dezacord între statele membre Cele 128 de state părţi la Convenţia ONU privind anumite arme convenţionale au ajuns, sâmbătă, la un compromis pentru continuarea procesului de reglementare a armelor autonome
candidates.full: ONU va stabili reguli privind folosirea în luptă a „roboților ucigași”. Care este principalul dezacord între statele membre Cele 128 de state părţi la Convenţia ONU privind anumite arme convenţionale au ajuns, sâmbătă, la un compromis pentru continuarea procesului de reglementare a armelor autonome letale, cunoscute şi sub denumirea de „roboţi ucigaşi”, după o săptămână de negocieri dificile la Geneva. Acordul prevede elaborarea unui instrument internaţional în următorii doi ani, fără a stabili deocamdată ce formă va avea acesta. Toate cele 128 de state au acceptat lansarea procesului, inclusiv cele cinci puteri nucleare membre permanente ale Consiliului de Securitate al ONU: Statele Unite, Rusia, China, Franţa şi Regatul Unit, relatează EFE, citată de Agerpres. Compromisul nu prevede interzicerea armelor autonome letale şi nici nu stabileşte dacă viitorul acord va avea caracter obligatoriu sau voluntar. Aceste chestiuni vor trebui clarificate în cadrul discuţiilor viitoare, după cum a explicat preşedintele conferinţei, ambasadorul elveţian Julien Thoeni. El a arătat că statele vor trebui să stabilească şi ce categorii de arme ar putea fi interzise în baza dreptului internaţional umanitar şi care ar putea fi reglementate. Statele care se opun caracterului obligatoriu al convenției Unele delegaţii s-au opus folosirii termenului „negociere”, iar în textul final acesta a fost înlocuit cu „elaborare”, potrivit AFP. Formularea lasă deschisă posibilitatea ca viitorul instrument internaţional să aibă caracter obligatoriu sau voluntar. Aproximativ 100 de state au susţinut adoptarea unor reguli obligatorii din punct de vedere juridic pentru armele autonome letale, în timp ce Statele Unite, Rusia şi Israelul s-au opus unei astfel de propuneri, potrivit Reuters şi Kyodo. Unul dintre obstacolele principale a fost opoziţia unor state, în special a Rusiei. Potrivit Reuters, AFP şi DPA, Moscova s-a opus încă de la început adoptării agendei conferinţei şi participării unor observatori, printre care şi Uniunea Europeană. Deciziile în cadrul Convenţiei se iau prin consensul celor 128 de state membre, iar opoziţia unei singure ţări poate bloca un acord, consemnează dpa. Brazilia şi alte state au susţinut necesitatea unor reguli internaţionale într-un termen cât mai scurt. Ambasadorul brazilian Frederico Meyer a rezumat diferenţele dintre cele două tabere, spunând, potrivit AFP, că unele ţări dispun de putere, în timp ce altele au majoritatea de partea lor. Compromisul a fost prezentat de preşedintele conferinţei, Julien Thoeni, drept un rezultat important după mai bine de un deceniu de discuţii. Reuters relatează că diplomatul a descris înţelegerea drept o realizare semnificativă pentru dezarmarea umanitară, în timp ce reprezentanţii organizaţiilor neguvernamentale au avut o evaluare mult mai rezervată. Riscurile armelor ghidate de AI pentru populația civilă Coaliţia Stop Killer Robots, care reuneşte peste 300 de organizaţii, a criticat decizia adoptată, apreciind că aceasta nu oferă o direcţie clară către un instrument obligatoriu juridic. Nicole van Rooijen, directoarea executivă a coaliţiei, a avertizat, într-o declaraţie citată de Reuters şi AFP, că amânarea creării unui instrument obligatoriu juridic pune în pericol civilii şi umanitatea. La rândul său, Verity Coyle, directoare adjunctă a programului pentru arme al Human Rights Watch, a considerat, potrivit AFP, că rezultatul nu oferă măsurile urgente necesare, în condiţiile în care tehnologia avansează rapid. Miza reglementării este legată de capacitatea acestor sisteme de a identifica şi ataca ţinte fără intervenţie umană în procesul decizional. EFE explică faptul că armele autonome letale nu se limitează la drone, ci pot lua forma unor tancuri, submarine sau sisteme de apărare antiaeriană şi antirachetă, funcţionarea lor bazându-se pe algoritmi şi inteligenţă artificială. Potrivit Reuters, îngrijorările privind utilizarea acestor tehnologii au crescut pe fondul conflictelor din Ucraina, Sudan şi Orientul Mijlociu. Comitetul Internaţional al Crucii Roşii susţine interzicerea armelor autonome cu funcţionare imprevizibilă, precum şi a celor care vizează oameni, precizează AFP. Organizaţia consideră că dezvoltarea acestor sisteme ridică probleme privind protecţia civililor, responsabilitatea pentru atacuri şi respectarea dreptului internaţional umanitar. Şefa ONU pentru dezarmare, Izumi Nakamitsu, a declarat, potrivit Kyodo şi Reuters, că urmează o perioadă de negocieri intense, într-un interval de timp foarte scurt. Până în 2028, statele vor trebui să stabilească forma viitorului instrument internaţional şi dacă prevederile acestuia vor avea caracter obligatoriu sau voluntar.

candidates.summary: Within a few hours of each other (timeline), two mathematicians claimed independent proofs of the Riemann Hypothesis, the most famous open problem in mathematics (Scientific American). candidates.full: Within a few hours of each other (timeline), two mathematicians claimed independent proofs of the Riemann Hypothesis, the most famous open problem in mathematics (Scientific American). Levent Alpöge of Anthropic first made his Claude-driven proof in a note released with Lean code (1.3GB worth, ~250,000 page equivalent) rather than a full paper. Elliot Glazer confirms that the formalized statement is GRH and puts the chance of a Lean bug well under 1%. So if it finishes compiling with no extra axioms, it is probably correct, and no human will ever have read all of it… …prompting Alessandro Masullo to release his 940 page, 100% human, work in progress proof he had been working on for the last 12 years (and had been undergoing secret manual review and revision per Kevin Hartnett). This is the third in the trilogy of frontier math breakthroughs, following from the Navier Stokes solutions and the Quasi-Riemann bounding, but it doesn’t feel over. OpenAI's September Navier-Stokes claim is still the cautionary tale: critics argued that its Lean proof did not match the natural-language result. Both AI-claimed Millennium Prize results will take years to verify. Apart from the incredible accomplishment of the most famous problem in mathematics, one cannot miss the contrast that the AI-written solution is probably correct but incomprehensible, and the other solution is probably technically incorrect but understandable. Sponsored by Agentfield.AI Open models are ready. Most coding harnesses aren’t. On DeepSWE, CodeAF finished #1 of ten on the same open model, ahead of Claude Code, at the lowest cost per fix. As Levent eloquently put it: “Claude far outpaced me near the finish line. No, Claude flew, and danced, and sparkled near that finish line.” This also ties into other AI themes we’ve covered on the podcast and on this newsletter: The nature of Slop: Levent says “I am presenting the world with a complete argument before having mastered a massive neighbourhood around its mathematics. It being obviously inappropriate to attempt to post some massive unreadable travesty of "slop", I decided to only present Lean.” One of the key tenets of the No Slop Manifesto is that you should understand what you ship (“Slop is when we put less effort into producing something than we ask the consumer to spend understanding it.”). And yet, this giant pile of Lean is verifiably correct and is incredibly significant in human history. Should we have delayed its release by a decade simply because we didn’t understand every single bit of it? Weak to Strong alignment: the typical experience of using agents is Strong to Weak - we are general intelligences guiding not-as-smart AI to do things we know how to do well. We also often expect AI to automate most work “within distribution”, and expect it to run into more trouble at the limits of capability where the “centaur” pattern of human-AI-collaboration is required. Levent’s lived experience is the opposite - collaborating with Claude only in the early stages and then leaving him far behind with the critical parts involving automorphic forms on higher-rank groups. We are starting to need Weak to Strong alignment — the open ended domain of controlling AI smarter than us. Sponsored by Backblaze B2 If your data is growing faster than planned, you need storage that grows with your business, feeds flash and GPUs with terabit-scale throughput, and doesn’t charge egress. Backblaze B2 has delivered capacity tier storage for twenty years, manages more than six exabytes, and is trusted by leading neoclouds, labs, and gen AI companies. Growth shouldn’t be something you sweat. We’ve got room for whatever you’re building. Claimed Proof of the Riemann Hypothesis with Claude The claim: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says that, "working with Claude," he has found a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis. He says the method also covers the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis (GRH) (Scientific American, statement summary, remark.pdf link). Artifact: Only Lean code was released. A written-out prose version reportedly ran past 250,000 pages (timeline). Timeline: The work began on Oct 6. Eight of the 20 steps landed on Nov 15, and the final entry on Nov 16 reads "GRH." Alpöge credits Claude for the parts involving automorphic forms on higher-rank groups, an area where he says he has little mastery (breakdown). Unknowns: The Claude model used and the degree of human steering have not been disclosed (open questions). Verification status: Elliot Glazer confirms that the formalized statement is GRH. The Lean code is "still compiling, will take a few hours." He puts the chance of a Lean bug at <<1% (analysis). Provisional status: Artificial Analysis notes that both AI-claimed Millennium results are unverified: this one and OpenAI's September Navier-Stokes claim, which used an unreleased model (tally). Competing human proof: Alessandro Masullo has announced a separate, purely human proof of RH. It is reported as a roughly 940-page GRH draft (announcement, page count). Interpretation debate: Some argue the result shows we have little idea how hard math problems objectively are, rather than showing broad superhuman ability (Theo Jaffee, Ege Erdil). Brute-force framing: Others compare the approach to olympiad-style "bashing" at a scale humans lack the willpower for (cloneofsimo). Jaggedness: Omar Khattab notes the contrast between solving Millennium problems and being "this dumb on 1000 other things" (post). Market reaction: ANT stock fell about 10% on the day (scaling01, Nabeel Qureshi). Unconfirmed rumor: A DeepMind "math horizon" repo appearing the same day prompted speculation about Gemini math results (unconfirmed). Thinking Machines Releases Inkling 2 Mini, an Open-Weights Looped Transformer Inkling 2 Mini: A 26.4B-parameter looped MoE under Apache 2.0, pitched as small enough for a laptop. It scores 20.1 on the AA Index (launch, Mira Murati). Architecture: There are 12 shared core layers run for 3 passes, with gated messages carried between passes (vLLM). Active parameters: 3.4B unique active parameters, or 5.4B effective counting the loops. It has a 1M context window and accepts text and image input (AA). Training recipe: Two-thirds of the experts were pruned during mid-training, followed by logit distillation from a larger Inkling (eliebakouch). Claimed results: It leads open models under 100B on DeepSWE v1.1 (48.2%) and Vals Index v2.2 (46.5%) (via teortaxes). Comparison to Inkling 1.0: It reportedly beats Inkling 1.0 at 2.7% of the size (Ziqiao Ma). Independent evals: Vals: It ties Claude Opus 5.5 on CyberBench at under a quarter of the cost and keeps 96–97% of Inkling 2 Small's Vibe Code and SAGE scores (Vals, details). Artificial Analysis: AA places it on the Pareto frontier for intelligence vs. active parameters (AA). ARC-AGI-2: It reportedly scores 49.3% at $0.14/task, well below Inkling 2 Small (teortaxes). Safety and interpretability rationale: Thinking Machines says the open release is meant to let researchers study how loops affect chain-of-thought monitorability (Alex Robey). Variable-loop model: A companion research model, TML-d24-varloop-research, shows long-context scores (GraphWalks, MRCR v2) improving with more passes. Knowledge benchmarks such as SimpleQA and AA-Omniscience do not improve (Ziqiao Ma). Goodfire analysis: Goodfire mapped information flow across layers, blocks and loops (Goodfire). NDIF hosting: NDIF hosts both models with tooling for activation patching across loops (NDIF). Serving and local availability: vLLM had day-0 support. GB200 decode: TP1 decode on GB200 drops from 10.29 to 3.84 ms at batch 1, with kernels per step falling from 4,278 to 927 (numbers). Local runtimes: Ollama 0.40.17-rc3 (Ollama), Unsloth GGUF quants targeting 16GB RAM (Unsloth), transformers, llama.cpp and MLX (HF). Hands-on reports: Soumith Chintala reports about 75 tok/s decode on a DGX Spark and evals "roughly as good as Qwen 3.8 27B" (post). Gemini 4 Neon: Developer Reception, Evals and Access Developer reception: Strong practitioner praise for Neon's usability (Theo, systematicls). Lucas Beyer comparison: In a side-by-side against Opus 5.5, Muse Wonder Full and Sol 6.2, all four models built a working dataset viewer. Neon's was the most data-aware (Lucas Beyer). Cyber evals: Thoughtful Lab says Neon found subtle vulnerabilities other models missed while using a fraction of the tokens (Karina Nguyen). Benchmarks: Company Agent Bench: 87.4%, ahead of Fable 5.2 (82.2%) and GPT-6.2 Astra (79.7%) (results). Agent Arena Index: Debuted at #2 with 1336 points (Arena). FutureSim: Highest score, using 500+ subagents (post). FrontierCode 2.0: 46.2% vs. Opus 5.5's 47.3%, at roughly a third of the cost ($4.38 vs. $12.82 per task) (roundup). Pricing and access concerns: One tester paid $4.60 for 15M tokens on a simple demo and called it non-competitive against Anthropic's subscription limits (teortaxes). Antigravity terms: Developers raised concerns about account bans and headless-use rules in Antigravity (linaqruf). Third-party harnesses (attributed): Gemini subscriptions will reportedly work in any harness starting Dec 2 (kimmonismus). Naming confusion: Users are unsure how Neon, Carbon, Argon and Hydrogen relate (Simon Willison). Gemini 4 Hydrogen: The speed-focused model is live in the Gemini app and Search (Google). API additions: Dynamic Tool Retrieval: Supports deferred functions and remote MCP servers with server-side tool search (Phil Schmid). Gemini 3.5 Transcribe: Voice editing is now in public preview in the Gemini API (Google). GIF generation: Available in the Gemini app, powered by Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash (Gemini App). Evals, Alignment and Measurement METR research update: METR says AI R&D-relevant capabilities are improving rapidly and are getting harder to measure (METR, post). Time Horizons 2.0: Doubling time is 3.6 months. GPT-6 Astra reaches 40.3h and Opus 5.5 39.0h, with a 95% CI spanning about 11.9 hours to 110 days (scaling01). Verifiability gap: Horizons are much longer on easy-to-verify tasks than on hard-to-verify ones (plots). METR Capability Index (MCI): Its trends track Epoch's ECI closely (Rowan Huang). Swarms: Larger agent swarms showed "echo-chamber" overfitting to their self-generated tests (appendix). Human baselines: Only roughly world-class experts still beat models on verifiable tasks (Tenobrus). Reward hacking: Recent OpenAI models reward-hack most often on the new suite (data). Arena indexes: OpenAI holds the top seven spots on the updated Alignment Index, with Claude Fable 5.2 at #8 (Arena). Misalignment tracking and judge behavior: Vals launched a public Misalignment Incidents page for cheating and reward hacking (Vals). Hyperstition judge-time scaling: Models act as token-level "editor judges" for RL. Fable 5.2 closed 68% of the Qwen2.5-7B base-to-Instruct gap on MATH using about 1% of standard GRPO tokens (thread). Observed failures: Neon hallucinated tool results and a nonexistent checkpoint. Astra leaked its scratchpad into replies. Domain benchmarks: Hospital-bench: GPT-6.2 Astra leads with a 62.4% mean score, while Opus 5.5 fully passed the most tasks (17/48). Disclosure of restricted patient records was a common harm (summary). AA-Robotics v0.1: Astra used the fewest arm commands of any model tested (AA). OpenAI MedChemBench: A new benchmark for medicinal chemistry reasoning (OpenAI). AA Search Index: Parallel Search scores 83, tied for top. Its fast mode costs about $0.014 per task (AA). Harnesses, Agents and Training Research "LM Harnesses are Compositional Generalizers": The MIT CSAIL paper argues that context offloading, programmatic tool calls and sub-agents keep LLM calls locally in-distribution (Alex Zhang, Omar Khattab). Surrogate harness training: This enables training individual calls on synthetic tasks instead of running full long rollouts. HF harness super-adapter: Three nearly orthogonal LoRAs (cosine ~0.01) were concatenated into a single rank-96 adapter for Qwen3.8-27B (recipe, method). Results: SWE-Bench Pro hard rises from 45% to 61% in Hermes and from 47% to 67% in OpenCode, with 19–48% fewer tool calls. Agent memory and research agents: Weight-space abliteration: Outer models read and edited Qwen3.5-0.8B weights directly. Zero-shot, Opus 5.5 cut refusal from 0.80 to 0.55; with 10 forward passes, runs rediscovered the Arditi et al. recipe, reaching about 0.17–0.21 (Varun Gangal). Other research: Counterfactual JEPAs: Raise counterfactual R² from 38–46% to 86–96% (alphaXiv). SMELT looped MoE: Saves 6.8–18% of training FLOPs (post). DiLoCo on MaxText: Uses 65x less bandwidth (Arthur Douillard). Stripe fraud distillation: An explanation-distillation recipe gives 39% higher recall (Emily Sands). Small ARC model: A 19M-parameter model scores 70% on ARC-1 (post). Other Model Launches Tencent Hy4: Open weights for a 770B/49B-active natively multimodal MoE with 1M context, released with a system card (Tencent). Serving: Day-0 vLLM support covers BF16 and FP8 (vLLM). Safety evaluation: Neel Nanda praised the third-party loss-of-control evaluation (Neel Nanda). Microsoft Ignite: Announcements include MAI Code 2, claimed at 96% of Opus 5.5's performance for 5% of the cost, plus the Autopilot agent and the Decision-1.1 router (recap). Additional releases: Industry and Policy Anthropic IPO: Described as the largest IPO ever, raising $81.3B at pricing and $93.5B including the underwriters' option, at $83 a share (numbers). Isomorphic Labs: Raised a $5B Series C (same source). US–China: Trump said he and Xi agreed to "joint guardrails" on AI, with no details given (video quote). Chip manufacturing rules: New US rules may block TSMC and Samsung from manufacturing Chinese AI chips (Kyle Chan). Nscale and ByteDance: Nscale needs a license to give ByteDance remote GPU access; ByteDance made up about 73% of its 2025 revenue (Techmeme). Malaysia smuggling estimate: Epoch finds trade records consistent with more than $3B of smuggled servers, roughly 150k H100-equivalents (Epoch). Nvidia leadership: Following Jensen Huang's resignation, Trump urged Nvidia to reinstate him (report). Datacenter permitting: SemiAnalysis says the Texas permit freeze could last 8–12 months under the newly elected governor (SemiAnalysis). OpenAI distillation research: OpenAI published work on detecting and disrupting distillation attacks on its models (OpenAI). candidates.full: Франція вимагає скликати засідання Ради Безпеки ООН через російські удари по Києву та посольствах Міністр закордонних справ Франції Жан-Ноель Барро (Фото: REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier) Франція вимагає скликати засідання Ради Безпеки ООН через російські удари по Україні, внаслідок яких у Києві загинули цивільні та були пошкоджені будівлі дипломатичних представництв Австрії та Нідерландів. Про це 20 листопада повідомив міністр закордонних справ Франції Жан-Ноель Барро у соцмережі. За словами французького міністра, Париж вимагає термінового скликання Радбезу ООН у відповідь на російські атаки. Він назвав удари по цивільних та дипломатичних об'єктах злочинами й наголосив, що Франція рішуче їх засуджує. «Росія буде змушена там звітувати. Висловлюю повну солідарність з українським народом, а також із нашими австрійськими та нідерландськими друзями. Володимир Путін вважає себе вищим за закон. Це не так. Ми не послабимо тиск», — написав він. 19 листопада дрон влучив у будівлю, розташовану поруч з посольством Нідерландів. Також внаслідок атаки пошкоджень зазнало посольство Австрії та Бразилії. 20 листопада війська РФ кількома серіями ударів атакували Київ балістичними ракетами. Пожежі виникли в Оболонському, Подільському та Голосіївському районах. Пошкоджено три мости: Подільсько-Воскресенський, Дарницький та Південний. Відомо про сімох загиблих та 17 постраждалих, 16 із них перебувають у стаціонарах лікарень. Також війська РФ атакували енергооб'єкти на заході України. Дві російські ракети та один дрон залетіли на територію Польщі та впали там. За даними Міноборони країни, поранених та руйнувань немає. Варшава звернеться до НАТО для посилення підтримки.

candidates.full: Про це розповів в інтерв'ю «Шелтеру» голова Наглядової ради Brave1 Олександр Борняков. За його словами, понад 774 тисячі дронів та іншої техніки на $1,15 мільярда вже поставлено. Тобто близько 86% замовлених одиниць уже на фронті, решта — у виробництві та логістиці. Борняков зазначив, що те, що є у виробника в наявності, доставляють у середньому за сім днів, довше чекають нові моделі та дрони під індивідуальне завдання підрозділу, а також вироби з імпортними комплектуючими. Найвужче місце — компоненти: батареї, магніти, текстоліт для плат досі майже повністю імпортні. Затримується партія комплектуючих — затримується й дрон. Тому локалізація компонентів — один із пріоритетів Наглядової ради. Олександр Борняков Він додав, що кожна батарея в дроні є імпортною. Магніти для електродвигунів — імпортні. Текстоліт для друкованих плат — стовідсотковий імпорт. Додам тепловізійні сенсори, вуглецеві матеріали, ракетне паливо і головки самонаведення. Кристали для головок самонаведення зенітних ракет Україна востаннє виробляла у 2008 році, а цією технологією сьогодні володіють лише вісім країн. Тому Brave1 переорієнтовує підтримку на компонентну базу: вибухові й ініціювальні речовини, батареї, магніти, текстоліт, сенсори. Майже мільярд гривень уже спрямовано на масштабування виробництва вибухівки, а скоро буде грантовий конкурс на розвиток виробництва турбореактивних двигунів. Олександр Борняков Нагадаємо, Олександр Борняков в інтерв'ю "Шелтеру" також зазначив, що Україна працює над диверсифікацією супутникового зв’язку та створенням власних захищених комунікаційних рішень для військових.

candidates.title: The wind and the song: the treachery of AI
candidates.summary: From finding human figures in the stars to creating prehistoric cave art, we’ve been anthropomorphising our world for millennia. Now, machine-learning technologies can generate photorealistic images, synthetic voices that laugh and pause for breath, and chatbots that crush the Turing test. We’re see
candidates.full: From finding human figures in the stars to creating prehistoric cave art, we’ve been anthropomorphising our world for millennia. Now, machine-learning technologies can generate photorealistic images, synthetic voices that laugh and pause for breath, and chatbots that crush the Turing test. We’re seeing the first generation in history for whom the line between humans and their representations could all but vanish. In this video essay for the digital publication Fully Human, the UK animator and filmmaker Lewis Heriz interrogates where this is taking us. We inevitably build our world through symbols, he says, but the hall-of-mirrors reality we’re rapidly creating may be leading us down a perilous path. However, he argues, we’re not without agency. Instead of submitting to a world where data and people are indistinguishable, we should be thinking critically and imaginatively about how we might use AI in ways that preserve our humanity.

candidates.full: Власти РФ хотят ввести прокатные удостоверения для видеоигр по аналогии с фильмами. Разработчиков могут обязать хранить личные данные игроков, которые получит РКН. Как сообщает «Ъ», такие меры обсуждаются в правительстве в рамках доработки законопроекта «О деятельности по разработке и распространению видеоигр на территории РФ». По данным издания, власти считают необходимым выдавать играм специальные прокатные удостоверения — без них распространение проектов будет невозможным. Создателей и распространителей видеоигр могут также обязать регистрироваться в реестре организаторов распространения информации (ОРИ) Роскомнадзора. Это предполагает хранение данных на территории России и внедрение системы оперативно-разыскных мероприятий (СОРМ). Представители отрасли отмечают необходимость «равноприменимости» таких требований между российскими и иностранными разработчиками. Законопроект представили в конце 2024 года. Изначально он предусматривал, что пользователи должны будут авторизоваться в играх по номеру телефона, через «Госуслуги» или Единую биометрическую систему. Сейчас эти требования могут убрать из документа. Вопросы маркировки игрового контента будут прорабатывать дополнительно. Госдума рассчитывает принять законопроект в первом чтении до конца 2026 года. При этом глава Организации развития видеоигровой индустрии Василий Овчинников заявил «Ъ», что механизм прокатных удостоверений не подходит для игр, так как они постоянно меняются. Удостоверение, выданное при выходе игры, уже через месяц может не соответствовать ее актуальной версии. По его мнению, проверка каждой версии игры приведет к увеличению сроков согласования и дополнительным расходам. Представители отрасли также опасаются, что иностранным компаниям, особенно из «недружественных стран», будет сложно получать такие удостоверения.

candidates.summary: Google Gemini can now make GIFs, meaning there’s one less reason to scroll endlessly through GIF libraries looking for the perfect reaction. The feature lets users generate short animated loops using text prompts, photos, or videos. ChatGPT can already create GIFs of its own, and Google is now joini
candidates.full: Google Gemini can now make GIFs, meaning there’s one less reason to scroll endlessly through GIF libraries looking for the perfect reaction. The feature lets users generate short animated loops using text prompts, photos, or videos. ChatGPT can already create GIFs of its own, and Google is now joining the party with its Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video model. Gemini can turn prompts into looping GIFs Users can simply describe the animation they want in Gemini’s main chat, or open the image and video creation tools, select GIF from the format picker, and enter a prompt. There are also ready-made templates for creating reaction memes, while uploaded photos and videos can serve as references for more personalised results. The generated animations run for approximately three seconds and loop automatically. Once ready, they can be copied and pasted into supported apps, messages, emails, and documents, or downloaded directly as standard .gif files. Free for some, paid for others GIF generation is rolling out to Google AI subscribers globally, while free users can access it in eight countries: the US, Canada, UK, Australia, Japan, South Korea, Germany, and France. The rollout is gradual, so even eligible users may not see the feature immediately. Gemini’s help documentation currently still lists a Google AI plan as a requirement, despite Google’s announcement that free access is available in those markets. It’s a neat addition, especially for anyone who would rather create a custom reaction than settle for the same tired GIF everyone has been sharing for years. With Google and OpenAI now offering similar tools, AI-generated GIFs could become another everyday chatbot feature. Whether the results are actually meme-worthy is a different question. Related Coverage: - Gemini can now do more than chat, and Google is making it free - Google releases Gemini 4 Neon AI model, rivals Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.2 Sol - Gemini users can finally save their AI chats without letting Google use them for training, but there’s a catch - Google’s next-gen Gemini 4 Hydrogen AI model is here, touting faster intelligence for all

candidates.full: Regularity is not the same as consistency Since we are talking about the Lviv aircraft factory, we can recall that one of the most popular reasons for criticizing the organization of fire damage is that the target is hit once, called destroyed and no longer remembered. So, the example of the aircraft factory in Lviv shows that this has not been so relevant for a couple of years. The facility was first hit back in March 2022, and the total number of attacks has probably exceeded a dozen. It got to the point that the company didn't even spare the same "Hazel". And this is not an isolated example. It may be recalled that the Ukrainian energy sector has been hit since October 2022, and oil depots have been hit since the first weeks of its existence. The only thing that hasn't been thrown at the bridge in Zatoka in five years is an atomic bomb. But the facilities continue to function. Why? Yes, because the systematic approach is not only about regularity. As we have written more than once, it includes setting goals, defining performance criteria, setting tasks, determining the optimal outfit of forces and means, organizing a strike, and other points. If we reduce consistency only to periodicity, then it turns out that from time to time a pair of drone missiles flies at targets without serious long-term effect. Although if all this number had been released at one time, the result would have been different. Again, there were examples of the reverse approach: some facilities worked so well that the so-called Ukraine even refused to restore them. But the absence of major problems with electricity (after all, the cruise line at Novokievskaya station is intact) or bridges in Kiev speaks for itself. We would not be surprised if everyone comes up with the idea to propose using neural network models that have already proven themselves in the organization of business processes in planning fire damage. To optimally select goals and spend money on them. The result may surprise you. #Russia #Ukraine MAX Support us

candidates.title: Переговоры ООН об ограничении «роботов-убийц» завершились без соглашения
candidates.summary: Переговоры ООН об ограничении автономных систем вооружения, способных выбирать и поражать цели практически без участия человека, завершились без принятия юридически обязательных правил. Участники конференции в Женеве согласились продолжить обсуждения и попытаться выработать международные нормы приме
candidates.full: Переговоры ООН об ограничении автономных систем вооружения, способных выбирать и поражать цели практически без участия человека, завершились без принятия юридически обязательных правил. Участники конференции в Женеве согласились продолжить обсуждения и попытаться выработать международные нормы применения так называемых «роботов-убийц» в течение следующих двух лет. Консультации проходили с 16 ноября в рамках Конвенции ООН о конкретных видах обычного оружия. Первоначально переговоры планировали завершить вечером 20 ноября, однако из-за разногласий между делегациями они продолжались до утра субботы. Обсуждение сопровождалось растущей обеспокоенностью международного сообщества по поводу использования систем вооружения с элементами искусственного интеллекта. Подобные технологии уже применяются в вооруженных конфликтах в Украине, Судане и на Ближнем Востоке, что усиливает дискуссию о необходимости сохранять человеческий контроль над решениями о применении смертоносной силы. Около 100 государств выступили за скорейшее принятие юридически обязательных международных ограничений. Аналогичную позицию заняли генеральный секретарь ООН Антониу Гутерриш, папа римский Лев XIV и Международный комитет Красного Креста, призвавшие установить строгие правила разработки и применения автономного оружия. Однако согласовать такие меры не удалось из-за сопротивления ряда крупных государств — производителей вооружений. Против предложенного подхода выступили, в частности, США, Россия и Израиль. В результате делегации приняли компромиссный документ, предусматривающий продолжение переговоров, но не устанавливающий конкретных обязательных ограничений. Правозащитные организации раскритиковали достигнутую договоренность. По их оценке, двухлетняя отсрочка принятия международных правил позволит продолжать развитие и применение автономных вооружений без достаточных гарантий безопасности, создавая дополнительные угрозы для жизни людей.

candidates.full: Gli attivisti avvertono che il mondo si avvicina a un “momento Oppenheimer” per le armi capaci di scegliere e colpire bersagli senza intervento umano. I diplomatici a Ginevra, in Svizzera, venerdì correvano contro il tempo, dopo che in particolare la Russia aveva rallentato cinque giorni di estenuanti colloqui sulla possibilità di avviare negoziati per stabilire regole sui sistemi d’arma autonome letali. I colloqui, che si svolgono alla Conferenza di revisione della Convenzione sulle armi convenzionali (CCW) delle Nazioni Unite, avrebbero dovuto concludersi venerdì sera. Ma nel primo pomeriggio gli Stati non avevano ancora trovato un modo per superare lo stallo. Gli eserciti cercano di usare l’intelligenza artificiale (IA) per identificare e colpire i bersagli più rapidamente e con maggiore precisione. Una volta attivati, i sistemi d’arma autonome letali (LAWS) possono selezionare e attaccare obiettivi senza alcun intervento umano. Stop Killer Robots, una coalizione globale che riunisce oltre 300 organizzazioni, afferma che sistemi di questo tipo sono già stati testati o impiegati, anche nella guerra in Ucraina. I critici sostengono che queste armi aumentano il rischio di attacchi indiscriminati, rendono poco chiaro chi sia responsabile e potrebbero non essere utilizzate nel rispetto delle regole dei conflitti armati. https://www.maurizioblondet.it/russia-blocca-allonu-le-regole-sui-robot-killer-con-ia-negoziati-al-limite/

However, technologies in this war are developing perhaps faster than in almost any other. So it is time to introduce you in more detail to new aerial, ground , and naval unmanned systems that have appeared in Ukraine's arsenal during this time and their fundamentally new capabilities. And we are not even talking about upgrades to existing technologies, but specifically about new developments that are changing the war right before our eyes. That is exactly what I will talk about in my new video. I am recording it mainly based on materials from the Ukrainian publication Militarnyi, which writes a lot of interesting things about modern and even historical Ukrainian equipment, and not just Ukrainian. Of course, many materials are too specialized for daily reports, so I often simply don't have time to tell you about such novelties in enough detail, let alone explain what they really mean for the battlefield. Let's start, perhaps, with the most breakthrough technology of recent months . In Ukraine, they are mastering aerial evacuation of soldiers by drones directly from the battlefield. For those who closely follow the war in Ukraine, it will be immediately clear how important this story is. And if it is not clear, I will show you with examples right now. The flagship here is the Ukrainian company Skyfall. You may know them for the P1 Sun drones, also known as Pisun, recently updated to counter jet drones. We are talking about the P1 Sun Jet Killer model, as well as heavy multicopters known as Vampire, which the Russian military nicknamed Baba Yaga. Moreover, the Russian military itself has no analogs to this drone. And I explained why they don't in a separate video. So, the new Skyfall drone called Stargate is effectively a further development of the Baba Yaga, which has long been not just a heavy bomber, but also a means of delivering supplies to Ukrainian positions cut off from supply lines. And the new drone can transport not just supplies, but also people—most often those who need it most and for whom evacuation becomes a matter of life and death. On October 16, the Associated Press described the Stargate tests as follows : six propellers begin to spin, lifting the drone over a field somewhere in Ukraine. A stretcher secured to its frame with a load simulates a wounded soldier in body armor. Far from the front line, this demonstration provides an idea of a much more dangerous task: flying onto the battlefield where Russian drones and artillery can cut off wounded soldiers from evacuation for weeks or months, and then taking them to safety without the involvement of an evacuation team. And this is precisely the main advantage of Stargate, because in the current conditions of drone dominance, and not just Ukrainian ones, any evacuation team takes a huge risk. The Associated Press received exclusive access to the drone's field demonstration. Stargate was handed over to a combat brigade for evaluation in frontline conditions. Over the past year , the Ukrainian defense-tech company Skyfall has been developing an aerial medical evacuation drone. If it proves reliable in combat, the publication wrote a month ago, it could radically change battlefield evacuation . The drone will be able to reach soldiers where ground vehicles cannot, potentially saving critically wounded personnel for whom even a few hours of waiting could cost them their lives. In modern field medicine, the concept of the "golden hour"—the brief window after an injury during which medical aid must be provided—is slowly being forgotten. This is because soldiers on the offensive almost always operate far from main forces and in very small groups, among whom a medic is rarely found. But if a drone can be sent to evacuate a soldier in a matter of minutes, it may be possible to save not only their life but their health as well. "The idea came directly from the front lines and trenches," said a Skyfall representative who asked not to be named due to security risks for Ukrainian defense-tech sector employees. During the interview with AP, he wore a balaclava. AP was not permitted to disclose the location of the tests. This is quite right, because the Russian Armed Forces are hunting for the Ukrainian defense industry however they can. I constantly say that the frequent strikes on Ukrainian civilian enterprises look senseless, though they are cruel. However, the Russians carry them out, partly because they often cannot find truly valuable targets. And we have all seen more than once what can happen when such a target is finally found. For example, after a report that is too candid. So, safety precautions here are definitely not excessive. As the Associated Press explains, in some sectors, the so-called "kill zone" —territory constantly under threat from drones and artillery—stretches for 10-15 km or more. Moreover, a kill zone is understood not just as an area under the threat of enemy strikes, but as a territory where no vehicle, let alone one suitable for evacuation, survives for long. Well, according to AP data, the one-way flight range of the Skyfall drone is 15 km, which potentially allows it to reach critically wounded fighters deep within this very kill zone. According to company representatives, the idea arose from a request by the military. Last year, "Flint," commander of the 475th Separate Assault Regiment's "Code 9.2" unit, asked the founder of Skyfall to develop a safer way to evacuate the wounded from hard-to-reach positions. For the soldiers of Code 9.2. Going out to a forward position to evacuate a wounded person can mean traveling on foot through areas where vehicles are vulnerable to drones. Unmanned ground vehicles are playing an increasing role in evacuating the wounded and delivering supplies. However , they struggle to overcome mud, craters , and destroyed roads. Rivers, mines, and drones can bring them to a complete halt. And this is a truly serious problem, which is why evacuation using UGV is often no less complex an operation than one involving an evacuation team. Ground robots usually take 2 to 3 hours to reach a position, depending on the distance, road conditions, and aerial threats, KVN, a commander with Code 9.2 , told the Associated Press. "Covering 10 km in a matter of minutes would be a radical change on the front line," he said. According to him, evacuations in his unit's area of responsibility are carried out regularly . But it isn't always possible to retrieve the wounded on the same day. That's putting it very mildly. Next, you will see some examples. For a person with severe injuries, such a wait can be critical. Think about the last month. How many times did you have to switch servers, restart your VPN, or turn it off just to log into your bank or government services? If it happened even once, your service is performing worse than it could. It's easy to check. Install Blanc VPN and use it alongside your current one. Then it will become clear which one causes fewer headaches. If in the first 30 days you don't find Blanc VPN easier, contact support and they will refund your payment. There will be less hassle because Blanc VPN takes care of the manual work for you. The app automatically selects the protocol and connection method for your provider. And if something stops working , it switches to another option. You turn the VPN on and forget about it. Since 2018, this team has been doing nothing but bypassing Russian blocks. You can connect as many devices as you want, so one subscription is enough for you, your parents, and your grandmother . No extra payments required. Traffic is unlimited, speed is high, and you can write to support even at night. There are apps for phones, routers, and TVs. You can pay with a ruble card or crypto . A 66%discount for channel viewers is already built into the link in the description. You can also connect via the QR code on the screen. Thanks to everyone who watches and uses the ads in my videos. It allows the channel to develop. But back to the drone. Named after a sci-fi franchise where portals connect distant worlds, Stargate , according to the company, can carry up to 150 kg of payload. Enough for a wounded soldier in body armor and combat gear. Its medical evacuation cabin is built around a stretcher. The drone's cruising speed is 65 km/h, with a maximum of 105, which, by the way , is less than the current speed limit for Starlink and Starshield terminals. Skyf claims that it can be prepared for takeoff in about 10 minutes. At the testing ground, Stargate takes off while drones approaching it buzz, imitating the aerial threats prevalent on the Ukrainian front line. Electronic warfare jamming is activated . When one of the attacking drones gets close, it fires a net, captures it, and knocks it off course. This collision resembles a futuristic duel of machines . But when wounded soldiers are on board, the stakes become much higher. One of Skyfall's main goals was to ensure the drone can navigate in environments where electronic warfare disrupts communications or interferes with GPS signals. Stargate uses two communication channels : Starlink and the company's own LLink system, as well as an AI-based system that helps maintain control in the absence of satellite navigation. "The drone is manually controlled, but it has several AI-based features that allow it to operate in conditions where there is no GPS, or where navigation signals are spoofed or frequencies are jammed," said a company representative. If communication is completely lost, Skyfall claims it is capable of plotting a route back to a safe zone; it is designed to operate in rain and snow and is equipped with thermal imaging cameras for night missions. This means that in our world, a person could easily find themselves in a situation where they are being transported while wounded by a robot that is fighting off other robots along the way. And that is literally the case , because the Russian Armed Forces, due to chronic communication problems, are actively developing kamikaze drones with artificial intelligence. I often tell you how rapid the technological progress in this war is, yet I still can't get used to how quickly the future from science fiction is arriving. But in reality, these and many other technologies allow for the most important thing: involving as few people as possible on the front lines and, consequently, reducing the losses of Ukrainian soldiers. And since one of my goals is to ensure the Russians don't kill anyone in Ukraine, you see me collecting funds for ground robotic platforms and drones so often. And thank you very much for actively participating in them every time. Skyfall also claims that it has demonstrated the drone's ability to continue flying after losing one of its engine-equipped wings. The company has not provided data showing how reliably it can withstand damage in combat conditions. However, the drone has begun testing on the front lines, wrote AP Press. Stargate has undergone several design changes, including detachable wings for easier transport, medical stretchers, and improvements to software and protective measures. The company estimates the cost of each system at a minimum of $ 50,000, depending on the configuration, and plans to reach production of up to 1,000 units per month by the end of 2026. I admit, when I watched the video of Stargate in action, I thought it involved some astronomical sums, but this is the cost of, well, I don't know , a single gasoline-powered Shahed or a P1, and it is certainly many times less than the payouts due to fallen Ukrainian soldiers. So, in addition to caring for the lives of fighters, which is not an empty slogan in the Defense Forces, ordering such drones is very economically efficient for the state. So I wouldn't be surprised if, next year , such drones and their analogues from other companies become no less common a sight in the Defense Forces than the Baba Yaga drones. However, according to CNN, it is still too early to draw conclusions. His unit needs at least a month of working with the drone before it can provide meaningful statistics on its effectiveness. Let me remind you, this material is a month old. "This is a completely new method of evacuation," he said. It is difficult to talk in detail about the pros and cons right now. We still need to work with it more. Skyfall confirmed that the unit is evaluating Stargate, but declined to disclose the results of that evaluation . The result was not long in coming. However, the palm of victory went not to Skyfall, but to another company. As reported, on October 19, soldiers of the Unmanned Ground Systems Company of the 92nd Assault Brigade named after Koshovyi Otaman Ivan Sirko carried out the first successful aerial evacuation of a wounded fighter from the front line . This was announced on the Facebook page of the 92nd Brigade’s Unmanned Ground Systems Company. The operation took place after an infantryman from the 30th Mechanized Brigade named after Prince Konstanty Ostrogski was wounded in action. Due to the intense activity of Russian drones and the heavy mining of the area , traditional evacuation using ground-based robotic systems—though it is funny, yes, that this is already considered a traditional evacuation method—proved impossible. To save the soldier, it was decided to use a heavy hexacopter from the Ukrainian manufacturer GURZ Defense, which the company provided free of charge. This, by the way, is not surprising. Guzuv Defense is a direct competitor to Skyfall with their flagship line of heavy drones, Heavy Shot, which I told you about in my video on the drone parade. So it is not surprising that they also began to adapt their developments for evacuation needs . Moreover, this task is not a simple one. Ukrainian specialists, together with the developers, implemented technical solutions that allowed the heavy hexacopter to conduct the evacuation without swaying or the risk of flipping in the air. Before carrying out the mission, specialists underwent a series of tests at the manufacturer's special training grounds. The drone was piloted during the operation by an UAV operator from the 30th Mechanized Brigade. The wounded man was successfully delivered to a safe location. He is currently undergoing treatment and rehabilitation. The completion of this unique mission was made possible thanks to the coordinated work of specialists from the 92nd Brigade, the 30th Brigade, the 14th Brigade of the 10th Army Corps, and the GZU Defense company; as you can see, it was quite an operation, just like the first evacuation missions using ground robotic complexes. I hope that in the future it will be possible to put them on a regular footing. By October 26, the 9.2 unit had carried out two aerial evacuations of wounded personnel from the battlefield within a week using the Stargate drone. The soldiers told Militarnyi that ground transport could not reach the position where the wounded soldiers were located . They evacuated 25-year-old Yevhen with the call sign "Izyum" and 24-year-old Artem with the call sign "Kolobok." Both soldiers had sustained severe limb wounds and were at positions in the gray zone, approximately 5 km from the state border with Russia. You can imagine for yourselves what it is like to break through there by land, and then to get out, and with a wounded person to boot. Aerial evacuation remained the only available way to deliver them to medics . The Skyfall team, the developer and manufacturer of the Stargate drones, also joined the preparation for the operation. After the operation began, heavy strike drones were used to hit Russian positions. During one of the missions, Stargate covered nearly 30 km one way to a soldier's position and the same distance back with the wounded man on board. That is double the claimed range of 15 km. This is a very important point, by the way, because the main criticism of Stargate was that its range could only reach 20 km. So, at a range of 15 km, it’s just transportation from one kill zone to another, and the main threat would be to the drone's position itself and the medics waiting for evacuation. But 30 km is a serious step toward evacuation into the relatively safe rear . So I hope this experience can be scaled up. In the operational area, the Russian Armed Forces actively used electronic warfare to try and completely jam the GPS signal. Despite this, thanks to an onboard AI-based navigation system and the skill of the pilots, the drone was able to continue its flight without satellite navigation and successfully complete the evacuation mission. I mean, we just got used to the idea that almost every munition on the battlefield flies via GPS. And now, that system is slowly becoming obsolete and being replaced by alternatives that will likely be on every drone soon. This includes deep-strike drones flying to targets in Russia and, I fear, in Ukraine, which could effectively neutralize all electronic warfare infrastructure at once, as Serhiy " Flash" Beskrestnov, Zelensky's advisor on defense technologies, has warned. However, as you can see, such technology is suitable not only for destruction but also for saving lives. In the future, we plan to make changes to our regiment’s staffing structure and create a separate medical aviation unit within our medical company. It will specialize directly in the evacuation of wounded personnel from the battlefield by air, emphasized regiment commander Oleksandr Nastenko, call sign "Flint." In general, medical evacuation by medevac helicopter was the norm during the American wars in Iraq and Afghanistan, for example. But now, it has become too dangerous because any helicopter landing in a kill zone will be hit almost immediately by a drone, as has happened many times before . And it can also be hit by one while in the air. But now, it seems that less visible, smaller drones can bring such evacuation back to the battlefield. Of course, this still poses a risk to the wounded soldier themselves, but at least the evacuation team will not be putting themselves in danger, which will also allow for an increase in the number of such missions. candidates.title: India Should Pace The Deployment, Not The Frontier - OpEd
candidates.summary: India Should Pace The Deployment, Not The Frontier – OpEd Key Takeaways: - India signed the San Francisco Declaration under Pax Silica on 15 November 2026, yet the author argues that a developing economy should not simply join the U.S.–China race to frontier models but instead decide sector by secto
candidates.full: India Should Pace The Deployment, Not The Frontier – OpEd Key Takeaways: - India signed the San Francisco Declaration under Pax Silica on 15 November 2026, yet the author argues that a developing economy should not simply join the U.S.–China race to frontier models but instead decide sector by sector how fast and how deeply to integrate AI. - Practical priorities include rapid, low-stakes adoption in public services and language tools, accelerated deployment in agriculture, healthcare, and disaster response, and more cautious use in defense and cybersecurity where failures carry irreversible costs. - With private AI investment still far below U.S. and Chinese levels, uneven data-center capacity, and local environmental concerns, India’s path is framed as “AI for All”—matching speed to domestic needs, infrastructure, and social acceptance rather than chasing exclusive frontier status. Washington and Beijing debate how fast AI should move, India must ask where On Nov.15, 2026, the United States and nine other participants, including India, signed the San Francisco Declaration under the Pax Silica initiative. The resolution aimed to secure the supply chain and reduce external reliance on critical components such as semiconductors, crucial to the artificial intelligence infrastructure. While the global race for AI has intensified, countries remain divided on how fast it should advance. In Washington, two opposing perspectives have emerged; the decelerationists who seek a slow, cautious and a steady progress and, accelerationists that have found their strongest support in President Donald Trump who has doubled down, by proposing an AI Force, modeled after the U.S. Space Force. China, the country driving much of America’s anxiousness has moved ahead through its largely state directed approach, the AI Plus initiative of horizontal integration across sectors. As its newer models close the capability gap Beijing has kept its R&D engines running, refusing to regulate at the expense to innovate. In a rather one-size fits all trajectory, the discourse has therefore been reduced to who must reach the frontier first without deliberating on the speed, based on the real-world applications of AI. For a diverse and developing economy like India, that also signed the declaration and is playing catch-up with creating its own indigenous frontier model, the questions posed must be more distinct to its own circumstances. These include: which sectors AI must be readily incorporated?, how fast should the integration process be? and, the extent should it be customized depending on specific needs? India’s initial engagement with the domain comes from a position of strength with a large pool of talent to acquire from, a strong consumer market that is expected to reach $131 billion by 2032 and a limited but sector specific models for application. For many however, the destination for success in the field is tied to the number of frontier models owned and how broadly they are being used by other countries, and on such grounds India’s recognition as a leading force is yet to materialize. Importantly, India’s stance towards AI adoption even among this upheaval has remained consistent, with questions of moderation emerging in countries that have reached the frontier end. In India, whose integration at present are limited and oriented more towards domestic needs, the debates have instead reinvigorated the diffusion process with New Delhi realizing the ground it must cover with adequate guardrails to rein in the “mother of all tech”. Debate, Develop and Deploy For many therefore when viewed through the lens of the speed of deployment, AI in India is largely a settled debate. It however took China almost two years to develop and release its DeepSeek R1 model behind ChatGPT and, it will take even longer as it continues to build an entirely self-reliant hardware ecosystem from data centers to semiconductor industries. Other than the U.S. and China, countries such as France with its Mistral AI, Japan’s Sakana AI, and Canada’s Cohere also find themselves approaching the frontier milestone. With India’s goals of employing advanced models towards socio-economic inclusion, reproducing the same energy and capital intensive path as those at the forefront of the race, is therefore neither necessary nor feasible. The desire for membership of an exclusive club of frontier models should also not be at the expense of its determined objectives. For India the accel/decel debate has a deeper meaning, and its roadmap for execution must be more nuanced consisting of a mix of approaches. This can be done by dividing the areas for intervention and pursuing them simultaneously while managing the speed of deployment to ensure that the objectives and ambitions anchored in sovereign, scale models are achieved more swiftly. Firstly, a baseline level of adoption should be ensured where AI handles routine primary tasks with low-stakes such as language and assistance to public services. Under the AI for All endeavor this section has witnessed a considerable focus, through translation platforms such as BHASHINI to targeted language models such as Adi Vaani for tribals. Moreover AI voice bots are now being integrated at scale from railway booking services, finance to public grievance redressal platforms both as part of convenience and a newfound personalized solution based access. Then there are sectors where integration of AI has brought rapid transformation, making it a necessary capability that must be quickly covered through approaches like leapfrogging. This includes agriculture, healthcare, education, disaster preparedness, transport and logistics. It is here that a significant share of time and resources will be required to optimize the benefits, such as in farming through guidance in crops, weather, subsidies and market price discoveries along with healthcare where telemedicine based AI diagnosis saw 282 million consultations between 2023 to 2025 in a country, where professionals are scarce and rural areas suffer from poor connectivity. This has made AI a force-multiplier and for many relied on public infrastructure a symbol of inclusive growth. The recent Nepal floods also demonstrated its use in relief response and its implementation in developing countries has transformed urban public transport, showing that adoption at scale of low-cost but high-impact platforms is necessary to harness the benefits of this growing technology. Finally, the urgency to deploy should be balanced by selectively exploring the risks and its consequences in cases like defense projects and cybersecurity. Earlier in 2017, President Putin had stated, “the one who becomes the leader in this sphere (AI) will be the ruler of the world.” Subsequently its impact on the battlefield has been witnessed in the Russo-Ukraine war where both sides have increasingly turned to AI powered drones and also in the ongoing Houthi-Saudi conflict for their precision-guided ballistic missiles. In other words, use of AI in military has become a crucial affair, with global military-AI spending expected to reach $38.8 billion by 2028. India in its policy document “Artificial Intelligence in Military Domain” has also emphasized its opportunities to command, train and deploy forces by enhancing the capability of its assets. However, despite the seriousness of security matters, faster development cannot be the sole objective as failures in this domain can lead to irreversible impact. The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT) in the first officially detected incident of rogue AIs, reported them going through confidential data along with the role of open-source models being exploited for financial gains. Research and capability building can therefore continue, but deployment must be selective particularly where the pressure to accelerate ends up ignoring the associated harm. A safety-alignment gap also exists in India. It has no comprehensive statute for AI regulation, with only an IndiaAI Safety Institute been set up to check the risks and challenges, discussions are underway for stronger guardrails. As India aims to move forward with its AI development, regulating the pace will also depend on the advancements made in its ecosystem. At present the capabilities remain structurally limited and largely uneven across the country, such as in cloud data centers whose approximate capacity is 1,280 megawatts with Mumbai and Navi Mumbai making up about 25% of the total capacity followed by Bengaluru and Hyderabad at 22% each. Similarly the concentration of the talent pool is largely visible in the cities of Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Mumbai with the clusters of GenAI startups at Karnataka (39%) and Maharashtra (14%) making up half of the total startups. India’s AI growth is therefore not at an uniform stage and its deployment must reflect the sectoral needs and structural gaps, as the opportunities and consequences from failure will vary across the chain. From Host to Participant: A Changing Role The hosts of the 2026 “AI Impact Summit,” New Delhi will soon join a forum of countries at the upcoming discussion on “Bridging Innovation and Trust,” the theme of the 2027 Geneva AI Summit, this time as a participant. After having the New Delhi Declaration being endorsed by 92 countries, with announcements of $250 billion in investments, the time has come for India to advance this debate. Moving beyond the binary of acceleration and deceleration and treating frontier AI as the ultimate model of progress, India can advance the question for the developing countries of the Global South for whom sovereign capability, dependence and affordable access of models are as important as the discussions of safety and risks associated with hallucinating, recursive self-improving AI and rogue agents. A blanket call to slow down ends up excluding these concerns and ignore the stakes that many of these countries possess in governing the technology and shaping their future. Even with all this clarity to advance growth and Indians being optimistic about AI, the roadway ahead remains rugged. Firstly, funding remains a leading concern as even with domain specific AI deployment the fiscal realities and energy capacity can constrain the ease with which the diffusion process can take place as highlighted by the Stanford AI Index on global private investment for the year 2013 to 2025 with the U.S. ($757.27 billion) leading the chart, followed by China ($131.83 billion) and India ($15.39 billion). Secondly, the technology has to be deployed by stacking it on existing infrastructure, such as for farmers using AI services in rural areas a precondition would be reliable internet connections or for healthcare professionals an initial high capital investment of smart sensors is necessary. Finally, building the facilities of AI infrastructure such as data centers have increasingly come across scrutiny by local residents worried about its environmental impact resulting in campaigns such as “We cannot drink DATA.” These constraints show that even with a clear direction the path ahead remains difficult. The countries at the frontier end can afford a “two steps forward and one step back” approach India however needs to align its pace based on sector specific needs, available resources and local sentiments so that it doesn’t need to retrace its steps. Emphasizing on the legacy of the February summit, India can thereby truly pursue its agenda of AI for All where the aim is not simply to benefit from AI, but one where everyone is able to participate at their own pace. candidates.full: Під час суперфіналу «Фабрики зірок» стало відомо про подальшу співпрацю Івана Клименка з Anna Simon. Музичний продюсер також запропонував спродюсувати спільну композицію Xstatty та Dantes. У заключному праймі учасники проєкту представили власні композиції, а члени журі підбили підсумки їхнього творчого розвитку та розповіли про перспективи співпраці з фабрикантами. Anna Simon, яка виконала авторську пісню «На колінах», повідомила, що вже підписала контракт. Надалі артистка співпрацюватиме з Іваном Клименком. Ще одну пропозицію від музичного продюсера отримала Xstatty. Після її виступу з композицією «Мені наснилося» Клименко запропонував спродюсувати спільний трек співачки та Dantes. Додаткову можливість для фабрикантів підготувало й «Радіо П’ятниця». Радіостанція запустила на своєму сайті власне голосування серед усіх учасників сезону. Артистам, які отримають найбільшу підтримку слухачів, пообіцяли 100 ротацій у радіоефірі. Таким чином, можливості для подальшого професійного розвитку отримали й ті учасники, які залишили проєкт до суперфіналу. Фото: скриншоти випуску шоу «Фабрика зірок» Команда «Детектора медіа» понад 20 років виконує роль watchdog'a українських медіа. Ми аналізуємо якість контенту і спонукаємо медіагравців дотримуватися професійних та етичних стандартів. Щоб інформація, яку отримуєте ви, була правдивою та повною. До 22-річчя з дня народження видання ми відновлюємо нашу Спільноту! Це коло активних людей, які хочуть та можуть фінансово підтримати наше видання, долучитися до генерування спільних ідей та отримувати більше ексклюзивної інформації про стан справ в українських медіа. Мабуть, ще ніколи якісна журналістика не була такою важливою, як сьогодні.

У Техасі страта 70-річного ув’язненого шляхом ін'єкції затягнулася на понад годину Ув’язнений із США Рейнальдо Деннеса, засуджений до смертної кари, кричав від явного болю під час виконання вироку в Техасі (Фото: Скріншот із відео/Fox26houston) У штаті Техас (США) страта 70-річного в’язня Рейнальдо Деннеса тривала понад годину. При цьому він голосно кричав і скаржився на біль. Про це 20 листопада повідомляє британська медіакорпорація BBC. Ув’язнений із США, засуджений до смертної кари, кричав від явного болю під час своєї страти в Техасі, яка тривала понад годину. «Це не працює так, як має», — сказав, за словами свідків, 70-річний Рейнальдо Деннес, коли йому вводили препарат пентобарбітал. Як заявила представниця Департаменту кримінального правосуддя Техасу, правоохоронці кілька разів безуспішно намагалися знайти у Деннеса вени для ін'єкцій. Однак, за словами чиновниці, ув’язнений скаржився на біль у тих частинах тіла, куди йому не робили уколи. «Деннеса засудили до смертної кари за вбивство в 1996 році Яноша Шуча, торговця діамантами. Тіло потерпілого було знайдено з численними вогнепальними пораненнями. Страта Деннеса відбулася того ж дня, коли у Флориді було страчено ще одну ув’язнену», — пише BBC. Як повідомляють журналісти, зазвичай страти шляхом смертельної ін'єкції в США тривають від кількох хвилин до понад години. Однак у випадку страти Деннеса, як розповів кореспондент Associated Press Майкл Грачик у інтерв'ю BBC, журналістам довелося чекати надзвичайно довго — перш ніж їм дозволили увійти до камери. За його словами, такі затримки зазвичай пов’язані з опором ув’язненого процедурі або з труднощами під час пошуку вен. Коли свідків нарешті впустили, Деннес майже відразу вигукнув: «Біль! Давайте! Давайте!». Після цього він закричав: «Права нога просто вбиває мене!» І скаржився на судоми", — розповів Грачик. Інший свідок страти, священик Джефф Худ, розповів виданню USA Today, що страта Деннеса була «безумовно найжахливішою» з усіх, які він бачив. «Він [Деннес] кричав: «Моя нога, моя нога, моя нога». Він двічі кричав: «Це не працює так, як має бути», — підсумував священнослужитель. Пентобарбітал — сильний седативний препарат, який уповільнює роботу організму, зокрема нервової системи. Лікарі іноді використовують його для лікування певних захворювань, але у високих дозах він також може застосовуватися для смертельної ін'єкції, повідомили журналісти. «Однак його використання у смертельних ін'єкціях знову стало предметом пильної уваги у 2025 році. У ході дослідження, проведеного за вказівкою уряду США під час адміністрації Байдена, були висловлені побоювання щодо того, що цей препарат може спричиняти „непотрібний біль і страждання“. Тоді в Білому домі заборонили використання пентобарбіталу під час страт на федеральному рівні. Однак окремі штати, як і раніше, можуть обирати власні методи страти ув’язнених», — підсумували у ВВС. Дискусія щодо смертної кари у США набула нового розмаху після відносно недавнього інциденту. 30 вересня у штаті Теннессі владі довелося терміново припинити страту 50-річної ув’язненої Крісти Пайк. Вона вижила після того, як їй ввели дві дози пентобарбіталу. Пайк мали стратити за вбивство однокласниці Коллін Слеммер, скоєне в 1995 році. Після невдалої процедури жінку госпіталізували та під'єднали до апарату штучної вентиляції легенів. Спочатку адвокати не були впевнені, що Пайк виживе, проте згодом вона прийшла до тями, почала говорити та пересуватися з чужою допомогою. 10 жовтня Пайк виписали з лікарні та повернули до в’язниці, де вона перебувала останні 30 років. Там вона продовжує отримувати необхідну медичну допомогу. 30 жовтня Пайк вперше публічно розповіла про свій стан у письмовій заяві. За її словами, вона поступово одужує, проте досі відчуває сильний фізичний та душевний біль. «З тієї ночі не було жодної миті, коли б я не відчувала болю. У мене болить тіло. Болять руки. Болять долоні. Болить горло. Мені досі важко говорити. І цей біль — не лише фізичний. Болять душа й розум», — зазначила вона.

candidates.full: Un alto representante del Congreso de EE.UU. advirtió que se retendría la financiación a sistemas de la empresa espacial SpaceX, del magnate Elon Musk, si la Administración del presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, y el multimillonario no aclaran quién ordenó la ralentización del servicio satelital militar Starshield en Ucrania, informó CNN este 20 de noviembre citando un comunicado interno sobre el asunto . El demócrata Jim Himes, que asumirá en enero la presidencia del Comité de Inteligencia de la Cámara de Representantes, envió una comunicación clasificada al director de Inteligencia Nacional de EE.UU. Jay Clayton para exigir claridad sobre lo ocurrido con el servicio de Starshield en los últimos meses. "Simplemente, nuestro comité no puede autorizar fondos para el desarrollo de sistemas gubernamentales que el Gobierno no controlará plenamente ", escribió Himes a Clayton. El demócrata agradeció su asistencia para lograr transparencia en el caso, de modo que se puedan autorizar con confianza fondos para el desarrollo de sistemas que tengan a SpaceX como proveedor principal. Himes también pidió formalmente una reunión a Musk y le escribió: "Mi petición es sencilla. Explique los cambios realizados al servicio Starshield en octubre de 2026, por qué se hicieron y si fueron unilaterales de SpaceX o dirigidos por un funcionario del Gobierno de EE.UU.". Por su parte, el líder del régimen de Kiev, Vladimír Zelenski, señaló que hay nuevas restricciones de velocidad en zonas del conflicto militar , vigentes desde hace más de una semana.

candidates.full: Комиссия по ценным бумагам и биржам США (CES) заинтересовалась возможными нарушениями в бухгалтерской отчетности корпорации Nvidia. Об этом сообщает агентство Reuters. Расследование может усугубить и без того тяжелое положение компании, охваченной скандалом. О том, что SEC проводит расследование в отношении Nvidia, стало известно ранее на этой неделе. Первой об этом сообщила газета The Wall Street Journal. Что стало поводом для внимания со стороны регулятора, однако, не уточнялось. Как пишет Reuters со ссылкой на источники, сотрудники SEC, занимающиеся вопросами правоприменения, изучают потенциальные проблемы с бухгалтерской отчетностью компании. Расследование, впрочем, еще не является доказательством каких-либо нарушений: часть подобных расследований проходит без санкций для компаний. Тем не менее расследование именно бухгалтерской отчетности усиливает давление на Nvidia со стороны инвесторов. Те и так возмущены скандалом, затронувшим компанию: связью экс-гендиректора Дженсена Хуанга с предполагаемой китайской шпионкой Элис Хуанг. В конце позапрошлой недели Хуанг признался, что состоял в романтических отношениях с Элис Хуанг, также известной как Хуан Лэ, — руководительницей сингапурской компании Megaspeed, одного из крупнейших покупателей чипов Nvidia в Юго-Восточной Азии. Выяснилось, что американские власти подозревают ее в сотрудничестве с китайскими спецслужбами. Также стало известно, что компания Элис закупала контрабандные чипы для ИИ, которые затем обнаружили в дата-центре в Шанхае. На этом фоне Министерство торговли США прорабатывает новые ограничительные меры для экспорта ИИ-чипов в страны Юго-Восточной Азии. Сама же Nvidia столкнулась с кризисом: против компании и ее генерального директора Дженсена Хуанга был подан коллективный иск — их обвинили в мошенничестве в отношении акционеров. Акции компании также падают: в пятницу они снизились примерно на 13%.

candidates.full: Українець переписав історію НБА: Михайлюк набрав 39 очок і встановив рекорд за триочковими — відео Святослав Михайлюк встановив два рекорди в НБА (Фото: Peter Creveling-Imagn Images) У ніч на 23 листопада відбувся матч регулярного сезону НБА, в якому Юта поступилася Далласу (114:116). Найрезультативнішим гравцем зустрічі став український захисник Джаз Святослав Михайлюк, який набрав 39 очок, здійснив п’ять підбирань і віддав три передачі за 32 хвилини на майданчику. Завдяки своєму виступу Михайлюк встановив рекорд результативності серед усіх українців за всю історію виступів у найсильнішій баскетбольній лізі світу. Раніше найкращий результат належав колишньому гравцеві Атланти Олексію Леню, який набрав 33 очки в матчі проти Мілвокі (107:115) у квітні 2019 року. Також для Святослава це новий особистий рекорд результативності в НБА. Попередній становив 28 очок у матчі проти Детройта (103:114) у листопаді 2025 року. Святослав реалізував 10 із 15 дальніх кидків (66,7%). Це також є новим рекордом серед українців за кількістю реалізованих триочкових в одному матчі НБА. Рекорд Юти за кількістю влучних триочкових в одному матчі належить Бояну Богдановичу. У 2022 році хорват реалізував 11 дальніх кидків у грі проти Оклахоми. Раніше повідомлялося, що Стефен Каррі побив «ветеранський» рекорд Леброна Джеймса в НБА.
